office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Rachelle Francis, appointed in 2023 and retained in 2024, is the only candidate. Elected by Cascade District voters only.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since 2023 (appointed, then retained by voters in 2024) and a Snohomish County public defender for 22 years, running unopposed.
highlights: Appointed to the Cascade Division in 2023 by a unanimous County Council vote; retained by voters in 2024 [S1]
22 years as a Snohomish County public defender, including involuntary behavioral-health treatment cases [S1]
Says access to community services is often key to reducing recidivism [S1]
